title: [Fabric] adding reset button for a table
summary: Adds a reset action for an individual table on the Fabric Platform Tables page in the Microsoft Fabric Mirroring app. Supporting changes were made in the Fabric Platform Mgt and Fabric Platform Http Client codeunits, and tests were added.
key_points: New reset action for a single table on the Fabric Platform Tables page
Fabric Platform Mgt codeunit extended to back the reset
Small change in the Fabric Platform Http Client codeunit
About 268 lines of new tests in TestFABPlatform
